main_qt module

Main GUI module for the School Management System using PyQt5.

This module provides the complete graphical user interface for managing students, instructors, courses, and registrations. It includes tabbed interface, data validation, and database operations.

class main_qt.SchoolManagementSystem(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any)[source]

Bases: QMainWindow

Main application window for the School Management System.

Provides a tabbed interface for managing students, instructors, courses, and registrations. Includes database operations and data import/export.

Variables:

  • tabs (QTabWidget) – Tab widget containing all management tabs.

  • student_tab (StudentTab) – Student management tab.

  • instructor_tab (InstructorTab) – Instructor management tab.

  • course_tab (CourseTab) – Course management tab.

  • registration_tab (RegistrationTab) – Registration management tab.

backup_db() → None[source]

Create a backup of the database.

Opens a file dialog for user to choose backup location and creates a copy of the current database file.

class main_qt.StudentTab(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any)[source]

Bases: QWidget

Student management tab widget.

Provides interface for adding, editing, deleting, and searching students. Includes form validation and course registration functionality.

Variables:

  • main (SchoolManagementSystem) – Reference to main application window.

  • table (QTableWidget) – Table widget displaying student data.

  • name_edit (QLineEdit) – Text input for student name.

  • age_edit (QLineEdit) – Text input for student age.

  • email_edit (QLineEdit) – Text input for student email.

  • id_edit (QLineEdit) – Text input for student ID.

  • course_combo (QComboBox) – Dropdown for course selection.

  • add_btn (QPushButton) – Button for adding/updating students.
